primary_gate: Reviewed native full PORT snapshot has duplicate id evidence (2 keys). A global receipt retaining it is rejected, so synthetic pass is not field-ready completeness or a model score.

counts.potential_existing_network_family_profil: requires unified materializer/retriever review; no claimed N

api_scope: Absent region means no region predicate on any API or SQL. If supplied, exact region goes to ROUTER/PORT/SUBNET/VM and parent SQL. Full directory retained across names for nativeId uniqueness; name filter is SQL-only. Global relation API has no region ownership predicate; undeclared metadata projected away.

entrypoints.prepare(params,receipts): strict request-bound normalized receipt assertions -> typed projected tables + conservative diagnostics
entrypoints.execute_local(params,receipts): stdlib in-memory SQLite verifier only; does not call official executor or services

per_resource.request: exact matching build.api_call resource dict, including method/endpoint/scope/autoPagination
per_resource.schema: verified columns including every declared field

receipt.trust_boundary: schema_verified and request are assertions from B trusted fetch layer, not authentication, a server proof, or atomic-snapshot proof. Runtime binding still requires independent B verification.
receipt.failure: ok must be true; success if present must be true; nonempty error or declared HTTP non2xx rejects at envelope or page. Missing/failed/partial input never becomes empty.
receipt.uniqueness: nonblank string id unique across each CI snapshot; identical/conflicting duplicates within/across pages reject. Distinct relation IDs can share a business link.
receipt.schema: all declared row keys required; successful empty results still need verified schema; true zero-row typed tables required, never _empty placeholder
receipt.unicode_and_types: UTF-8 encodable strings only; display name/cidr text or NULL; nullable FK blank-only normalized toNULL; opaque nonblank IDs preserved, not trimmed

relations: router_relation.portId=router_port.id; router_relation.subnetId=SUBNET.id with parent region guard
vm_relation.subnetId shares referenced subnet key; vm_relation.portId=vm_port.id
identity_guards: one ROUTER per(region,nativeId), one VM per(region,resId); repeated cross-region native/resId allowed, never bare global join. PORT matching proven router+VM roles simultaneously rejects. Known cross-region port/subnet edges and ambiguous cross-region references reject.
VM_port_role: known router ports are excluded from VM-side candidates. Other subnet-attached endpoints are either proven VM references or explicit unresolved/unknown endpoints; they are not silently certified as non-VM.

hierarchy_rows.grain: distinct VPC identity × referenced subnet identity × proven VM identity or unknown endpoint group. Known VM repeated through multiple ports within subnet collapses; same VM in different subnets remains listed in each subnet.
hierarchy_rows.zero_policy: zero-child parent retained; subnet with no known VM retained; missing/NULL associations retained as status/reference fields

parent_counts.known_vm_count: COUNT DISTINCT VM.id across all subnets of parent; never sum per-subnet VM counts
parent_counts.has_unknown_subnet_link: 0/1 presence flag, not number of missing subnets
parent_counts.unknown_vm_endpoint_count: number of distinct displayed unknown endpoint groups in hierarchy, not certified number of absent VM objects

total_contract: catalog_vpc_count independently counts fetched full region/global ROUTER directory before joins; selected_vpc_count counts exact name/region selection before joins. When selected parent set empty, ordinary api_call+sql emits one row_kind=summary_only row with totals (global true-empty yields0,0); remaining identity/detail/count fields NULL. Nonempty rows repeat totals.
null_unknown_and_completeness: Missing nativeId parent retained as unknown. Nonempty unresolved subnet/VM/PORT refs remain explicit. prepare also diagnoses VM missing resId and unattached/unattributed PORT/relation keys that never reach hierarchy; inability to prove them outside selected parents conservatively blocks completeness. Nullable keys project toNULL before SQL; B must load projected tables.
display_contract: NULL/empty/blank-only requested name/CIDR values preserved, counted by distinct displayed resource identity in requested_display_unknown_counts, and requested_display_values_complete=false. known_relationship_graph_complete is separate; business_complete requires both and never certifies live/server/official completeness.
complete_scope: known_relationship_graph_complete/business_complete apply only to prepared local receipt assertions and known relationships/requested values. No live atomic snapshot, B receipt trust/execution, formal business acceptance, model score or native field readiness claimed.
pagination_long_requests: strict success/pages/total/size/unique identities; boolean metadata rejected. No arbitrary truncation. build.transport_diagnostic measures expanded api_call+sql compact UTF-8 JSON: core>4096 is blocked_core_length, with boundary/bytes/handling; full metadata size does not determine this flag. Static placeholder/core/full measured separately. Final B envelope/official4096B/depth boundary remains unverified; B must enforce accepted final boundary or adopt a verified compact/bound-parameter representation. Long semantic entities are not declared illegal.
runtime_gates: native PORT duplicate source must receive authoritative handling; never fold to fake completeness
B must actually execute prepare projected rows and true typed-empty schema
trusted fetch/request/schema/page receipts and live consistency require B verification
final transmitted JSON boundary/depth and official business/relationship acceptance remain unverified
